issues: Narration omits the opening condition, “And when they shall have received this,” so the first excerpt is a fragment; the quoted text itself is exact and contiguous.
Summary accurately reports the sequence, but narration quotes only the bread-giving clause and omits that the Lord taught for three days and afterward showed himself often.
The unspecified occasion of bread-giving is an acknowledged uncertainty; avoid implying any particular appearance or occasion.

3 Nephi 26:15 has an ambiguous construction around the ascent, the second time he showed himself, and going unto the Father; the summary treats these as a sequence, but their precise relationship is unclear.
